Studio edition · Easy and Manual

Claims Processing, built with brainfreeze studio

The Claims Processing agent on real SharePoint lists that hold the workshop's synthetic records, with its own managed app. Easy mode has brainfreeze studio build all of it; Manual mode builds the same thing by hand.

Synthetic data only: every record and figure is fictional workshop data, not customer results, verified emissions evidence, a compliance determination, or a credit purchase.

Use the same lists, agent and managed app in either mode. Keep the agent in Draft. Expected results below are checks to run, not claims that a live run has passed.

Progress remains available on this page but will not persist after you leave.
Found something inaccurate? Use Report an issue on that step. It opens a prefilled GitHub issue for your review and never submits automatically.

0 of 9 complete

1

Get the tools and sign in once

Step 1 of 9

Action

Clone the library, get brainfreeze studio from your workshop host (it has no public download yet), install Microsoft's managed apps CLI, and sign in with the account that can make agents and apps in your environment.

Expected result

The library is cloned, `python3 -m brainfreeze_studio --help` lists its commands, `ms auth status` shows your account, and `az account show` shows your tenant.

Command 1
git clone https://github.com/microsoft/aibast-agents-library.git
Command 2
npm install -g @microsoft/managed-apps-cli
Command 3
ms auth login
Command 4
az login
Screenshot pending

A real capture will be added after this step is run live and reviewed. No screenshot is shown; this is not evidence that the step has passed.

2

Build and deploy everything with one command

Step 2 of 9

Action

Run brainfreeze studio's AIBAST command for this workshop, with your SharePoint site and your environment.

Expected result

It prints the 4 lists it made and filled, the Draft agent it deployed, and the managed app's play link. The first run opens one browser sign-in for the app's repository.

Command 1
python3 -m brainfreeze_studio aibast claims-processing --library ./aibast-agents-library --site https://<your-tenant>.sharepoint.com/sites/<your-site> --environment https://<your-org>.crm.dynamics.com --deploy

2

Create Claims Processing Claims from its CSV

Step 2 of 26

Action

On the site: New, List, From CSV. Upload claims.csv. On Customize, keep Title mapped to the Title column. Set ClaimId, Claimant, PolicyNumber, PolicyType, DateOfLoss, DateFiled, LossType, Adjuster, Status, SupportingDocs to Single line of text. Keep dates as ISO text, not Date and time; years and numeric-looking identifiers stay text (2022, not 2,022). Keep ClaimedAmount, FraudScore as Number. Name the list Claims Processing Claims. Preserve the CSV column order.

Expected result

4 fictional records, including Burst pipe in upstairs bathroom caused water damage to ceiling, walls, and flooring in two rooms (ClaimId CLM-2025-7001), with Claimant Margaret Sullivan.

Screenshot pending

A real capture will be added after this step is run live and reviewed. No screenshot is shown; this is not evidence that the step has passed.

3

Create Claims Processing Policy Details from its CSV

Step 3 of 26

Action

24

Register the app and connect the lists

Step 24 of 26

Action

In that folder, register the app with Microsoft's CLI and bind each list with your SharePoint connection.

Expected result

ms.config.json lists one SharePoint connection with the 4 tables, and generated/services has a service for each list.

Command 1
cd claims-processing-app/managed-app
Command 2
ms app init --display-name "Claims Processing Workspace Manual" --repo native
Command 3
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Claims Processing Claims" --use-sso
Command 4
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Claims Processing Policy Details" --use-sso
Command 5
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Claims Processing Fraud Indicators" --use-sso
Command 6
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Claims Processing Adjuster Notes" --use-sso
